name: TrustDemoIND01
title: TD.IND.01 Foreign doses imported as verified
description: Of the foreign DVCs a clinic scans to verify, the proportion whose dose is recorded as verified.
guidance: A definition only: it states no target and no value. Data elements: CWT.header.4 Key identifier (kid); CWT.payload.1 Issuer (iss); IMMZImmunization.primarySource Primary source. Decision tables: TD.DT.01. Requirements: STT-VER-001, STT-VER-006, STT-VER-008. The populations are described, not computable: this guide carries no CQL.

population.description: Foreign DVCs scanned for verification in the reporting period.

criteria.expression: COUNT of foreign DVCs the clinic's HCERT library is asked to verify in the reporting period, verified or not

population.description: Foreign DVCs scanned for verification in the reporting period whose dose was recorded as verified.

criteria.expression: COUNT of foreign DVCs the clinic's HCERT library verifies in the reporting period (CWT.header.4 found on the trust list) WHERE the dose is imported as an Immunization (IMMZImmunization) with primarySource = true

stratifier.description: the STT-VER-008 reason, for DVCs that did not verify
the participant that signed the DVC
